software_base.note: forked from kanoqwq/mu300-linux minikano-openwrt-feats like the U30 Air; this profile records where NX302J diverges

hardware_reference.note: used for the shared platform transport, kernel-module build and installer layout only; NX302J board data comes from its own stock Android firmware

board_notes.wcn_bus: SDIO, not PCIe. No tty-sdio/ tree exists upstream, so sprdbt_tty is built from tty-pcie/ with hif_type patched to HW_TYPE_SDIO; BT channels are tx=3 rx=17.
board_notes.trial_trigger: adb reboot is enough; verified 2026-11-21 COM9 appears at 9 s and stays up past 260 s. A manual power cycle is not required.
never: do not mark the Linux slot successful: LK then stops decrementing tries and never falls back to Android
do not switch the active Android slot to _a: its super has no system
do not write misc[0:32] without first checking for bootonce-bootloader
